candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to score or prioritize already-segmented accounts against ICP prose in a connected GTM context. Not for assigning segment labels, account research, lead scoring, rubric authoring, numeric scoring, or repository management.
candidates.rationale: Direct labels-in task and sibling exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to score, rank, qualify, or prioritize accounts using supplied ICP segment labels and qualitative fit bands in a connected GTM context. Not for assigning labels, researching companies, scoring leads, authoring rubrics or point systems, numeric scoring, or managing the context repository.
candidates.rationale: Covers common scoring verbs and makes the supplied-label and qualitative-band contract explicit.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user wants strong-fit, good-fit, weak-fit, or no-fit assigned to companies that already have ICP labels. Not for segmentation, enrichment, account research, lead workflows, scoring-model design, arithmetic, or context setup.
candidates.rationale: Names the observable output vocabulary and excludes scoring-model design.
